b4.name: B4 cross-species: priming-blunted mouse LPS genes vs human tolerance
b4.preregistered_mismatch: Mouse is HETEROLOGOUS priming (CpG or polyI:C, then LPS, 4 h apart, BMDM); human is HOMOLOGOUS tolerance (LPS then LPS, monocyte-derived macrophages). The two contrasts are not the same biology.

mouse.design: ~ priming + challenge + priming:challenge (pydeseq2), conditions FF FL CF CL PF PL, 3 replicates each
mouse.rule: LPS-induced in the naive arm (padj < 0.05, log2FC > 1) AND priming x LPS interaction padj < 0.05 with log2FC < 0

human_primary.contrast: LPS-tolerised -> LPS restimulation vs untrained (RPMI) -> LPS restimulation, donor-paired moderated test

human_secondary.contrast: LPS-tolerised vs control at day 6, resting (no restimulation), donor-paired moderated test
